budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Board signed an Accounts Payable Warrant in the amount of $287,397.59.
budget_items.quote: the board signed an accounts payable warrant in the amount of $287,397.59.

budget_items.topic: Lunenburg Snow Riders RTP Trails grant
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Snow Riders were notified they are recipients of an RTP Trails grant; over the past five years the club has received $120,000 in grant funding.
budget_items.quote: they are recipients of an rtp trails grant in the amount of $49,524.89.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Lions Club believes the country fair raised over $12,000 for the Food Bank.
budget_items.quote: they are 99% sure they made over $12,000 for the food bank.

budget_items.topic: Lunenburg Water District garage and office loans
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Water District voted to move forward with investigating loans to fund a garage and office.
budget_items.quote: there was a vote to move forward with the investigation of loans to fund a 1.2 million dollar garage and office for the water district.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Nexamp's community shared project first-year savings are projected to be over $20,000; its standard offer to residents is a 15% discount.
budget_items.quote: the first year of savings is projected to be over $20,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: If the Town received 100% of the project, the first year would generate $36,400 in savings.
budget_items.quote: the first year would generate $36,400 in savings.

budget_items.topic: Turkey Hill Middle School 10-year capital plan
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The 10-year capital plan for Turkey Hill Middle School is projected to cost close to $22 million by 2024.
budget_items.quote: the cost by 2024 will be close to $22 million.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Lunenburg public schools received $882,000 in grant funding for FY2016, with federal grants increasing by $200,023.
budget_items.quote: the lunenburg public schools received $882,000 in grant funding for fiscal year 2016, with federal grants

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A school building project change order in the amount of $49,182 was reported for an added drain and related items.
budget_items.quote: there was another change order in the amount of $49,182

budget_items.what_was_recorded: New aggregation rates are 11.98 cents for the first six months, a decrease of 2.01 cents; 8.9 cents for May 1 to November 1, 2016; the current rate is 11.3 cents, a decrease of 2.4 cents.
budget_items.quote: 11.98 cents for the first six months. this is a decrease of 2.01 cents from the rate in november 2014.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Refunding the 2004 loan would give a present value savings of $113,000 over nine years: $97,000 exempt debt and $16,000 non-exempt debt; the $97,000 equals about a penny on tax bills.
budget_items.quote: we can re-fund this with a present value savings of $113,000 over the nine remaining years.
